messages:
sophie: handing off INC-2026-42 — token-store latency impacting hosted API (us-west). I'm the primary for the past 3hrs, handing to maria for the overnight window. summary: high p95 write latency to token-store causing timeouts for short-lived requests, client retries causing bursts. mitigation in progress: scaled token-store pool + enabled read-preferring fallback; started prefix cache warm-up; increased per-request timeout to 5s for the gateway to reduce user errors. customer impact: intermittent 504s for generation endpoints in us-west, affecting approx 12% of requests based on 10m sampling. the redirect to fallback model increases cost but keeps responses. alerts are firing: token_store.write.latency.p95 > 800ms, gateway.5xx.rate > 2%.
incident-bot: INC-2026-42 acknowledged by primary sophie at 1766003456. Pager duty: paged @maria as incoming primary. Severity: P1. link: https://redwood.internal/inc/INC-2026-42
sophie: runbook pointers — token-store runbook (ops playbook) section 2.3 for cache-warming steps, section 4 for emergency rollback of latest token-store config. runbook: https://wiki.redwood/internal/runbooks/token-store
maria: taking over. thanks @sophie — i'm oncall for the next 8 hours. quick q: is there any ongoing deploy that could be related? last successful deploy to token-store was 19:02 UTC, no deploys since. can you confirm?
sophie: confirmed no deploys after 19:02. the spike started ~19:14 UTC. root cause investigation points to increased retry storms from gateway when latency climbed — circuit-breaker thresholds were too lenient. i've raised a temporary circuit-breaker patch on the gateway to reduce retries (patch id: cb-patch-1766). i pushed it at 20:03 UTC. monitoring shows partial reduction in write QPS to token-store.
ajay: looking at metrics — write QPS dropped ~28% after cb-patch, but p95 still ~640ms. token-store pods show uneven GC pauses on two nodes (nvme-backed). triggering cordon + restart for those nodes may help. are we ok to drain node ip-10-2-7-45?
maria: fine to drain. please coordinate with infra. also, if we restart pod, ensure cache pre-warm script runs (see runbook step 2.3b).
ops-bot: infra: scheduled cordon & drain for ip-10-2-7-45 at 1766005200 by ajay. will attempt graceful pod eviction with 300s timeout.
ajay: started drain at 1766005220. watching. logs show GC spikes correlate with p95 bumps at 19:18 and 19:46. guessing JVM tuning regression in last config (but no deploy recorded) — could be memory pressure.
sophie: customer comms: notified SRE-updates channel and opened a ticket for top 5 affected customers. recommend holding any non-critical deploys till incident is closed. also note that dedicated customers on us-west-dedicated are not affected.
maria: accepting handoff. my priorities while oncall: 1) finish node drain + pod restart + ensure cache warm-up, 2) validate p95 < 400ms sustained for 10m, 3) rollback the gateway retry patch if it causes regressions, 4) update incident timeline. i will be primary, ajay is secondary until 02:00 UTC, then @sophie will be listed as backup on-call via the rota app.
sophie: a couple of operational notes — there is a temporary run of ai-cache-warm: run `kubectl exec -it cache-warm -- /warm.sh --prefixes /etc/warm-list` after pods are ready. also watch prefix_hit_rate metric (should hit > 85% within 5m).
ajay: node restart completed at 1766005600, pods restarted, cache-warm script kicked and reported success. p95 dropped to ~420ms within 3m of restart, steadying.
maria: good. i'm enabling extra logging for token-store write paths for 10m to capture any anomalous retries. logging level set to DEBUG at 1766006000.
sophie: if things look stable for 30m and p95 < 400ms, we'll move to monitoring-only and close the incident. otherwise escalate to infra oncall for deeper node IO investigation.
incident-bot: next update requested in 15m. reminder: update INC ticket with timeline and mitigation steps. auto-assign: maria.
maria: acknowledged. i'm going to sleep on a 20-minute check cycle and escalate immediately if p95 creeps back. leaving handover note in the ticket: "handoff at 1766003456 from sophie to maria; mitigations: cb-patch applied, node ip-10-2-7-45 drained & restarted, cache-warm ran, gateway timeout increased to 5s; monitoring in progress." will also annotate any client error samples.
ajay: all good from infra side for now. if p95 > 700ms again, suggest scaling token-store pool by +2 replicas as temporary capacity buffer.
maria: thanks. i'll keep the thread updated. handing off active tasks: ajay — infra restart & watch, sophie — customer comms & ticket updates. i'll be primary. signing in. :thumbsup:"
